title: Instant paywall, disgusting
body: Gives a long ahh form in the name of personalization only to throw a paywall in face. Without even letting us try the app. Would not recommend
author: HolisticAP

title: Worst App I have ever used.
body:
I have had some poor experiences, but nothing comes close to this app.

Never purchase this. The chatbot is very bad and repetitive. You can literally use chatgpt and still get better answers.

What’s worse is, they charge you 3k for the year with ZERO option cancelling and getting a refund.

So, go ahead and safe your money from this scam.
author: Dhruv0824
